items.title: 米ＥＶリビアン、ウーバーから2.5億ドル投資見込む　「Ｒ２」販売好調
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Akash Sriram　Abhirup Roy

［２９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Akash Sriram　Abhirup Roy

［２９日　ロイター］ - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）メーカー、リビアン・オートモーティブのＲＪ・スカリンジ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２９日、年内に自動運転のマイルストーン（中間目標）を達成し、米配車大手ウーバー・テクノロジーズによる２億５０００万ドルの投資が実施されることを「非常に確信」していると述べた。

ウーバーは２０３１年までにリビアンに最大１２億５０００万ドルを投資する予定。初期投資は３億ドルで、残りは自動運転のマイルストーン達成が条件となっている。

リビアンが自動運転機能を搭載した新型小型ＳＵＶ（スポーツタイプ多目的車）「Ｒ２」をウーバーに供給し、２８年にウーバーのネットワーク上で運行開始を目指している。当初は複数の都市で開始し、約１年半かけて計２５都市程度へ拡大する予定だ。

スカリンジ氏は、Ｒ２の販売が好調だと説明した。

Ｒ２は全体の期間を通じて販売されていた最初の四半期で、ＳＵＶ、ピックアップトラック「Ｒ１」、配送用バンを上回る販売台数を記録。リビアンの納車台数で過去最高となる１万９２４８台を達成するのに貢献した。

Ｒ２の廉価版を来年投入する予定で、米ＥＶ大手テスラの「モデルＹ」に対抗する。車両価格は４万５０００ドルからに設定する。

リビアンはドイツ自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ） とも合弁事業を展開している。

スカリンジ氏は、リビアンの技術を搭載した最初のＶＷ車となる欧州向けの低価格ＥＶの開発が、２０２７年の発売に向けて順調に進んでいると強調。ＶＷはリビアンのＡＩ（人工知能）アシスタント技術についてもライセンスを取得する意向だと明らかにした。リビアンのソフトウエアをＶＷの車両に統合する際に問題が生じているとの報道を「根拠のないうわさだ」として一蹴し、両社の関係は「非常に良好だ」と強調した。

FAST

LAHORE, Oct 30 : England coach Brendon McCullum backed Harry Brook's leadership despite the team's failure to reach the final of the one-day international tri-series in Pakistan, saying the young captain had grown from a challenging assignment.
England lost their opening three matches of the tournament before signing off with a consolation 55-run victory over Sri Lanka in Lahore on Thursday.
Brook's side looked set for another defeat after Sri Lanka's Pavan Rathnayake struck a century, but England rallied to bowl out their opponents for 331 while defending a target of 387.
"He (Brook) will have learned a lot from getting thrust into a situation like this where the game is travelling at breakneck speed, and you're having to make decisions which can win or lose a game," McCullum told Sky Sports.

The 45-year-old praised Brook's tactical awareness and leadership, saying the batter had earned the support of the dressing room.
"He's one of the best tactical captains I've ever come across," McCullum said.
"He's got such an astute brain. He wears his intelligence lightly externally, but he's a very switched-on man and a very switched-on cricketer. He has the respect of the entire dressing room.
"He leads them. They follow him. He's interactive with his leadership. It's not just him out there on his own. He does call upon many other people as well."
England's preparations for the 2027 ODI World Cup will continue with a white-ball tour of Australia in November.
Batter Jacob Bethell and fast bowler Jofra Archer are expected to return after missing the Pakistan tri-series, while former captain Jos Buttler remains sidelined as he recovers from hamstring surgery.

items.summary:
トルコ有数の観光地カッパドキアで29日、「妖精の煙突」と呼ばれる奇岩の一部が崩落。落下した岩の破片が当たり、2人が死亡、5人が負傷した。

現場は、人気観光スポットのギョレメ野外博物館の近く。

崩落が起きたのは現地時間午後3時15分ごろ。この地域で大雨が降った後だった。

救助隊ががれきの中で活動し、救急車や掘削機も救助作業に投入された。

トルコ中部にあるカッパドキアは、火山活動と数千年にわたる浸食が生み出した景観で世界的に知られる。

「妖精の煙突」はこの地域のシンボルの1つで、世界中から観光客を引き付けている。

items.title: アングル：米ビックテック決算「現金が王様」、ＡＩ投資の成算に厳しい視線
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Aditya Soni　Deborah Mary Sophia

[２９日 ロイター] - キャッシュフローが王座に返り...
items.body:
アングル：米ビックテック決算「現金が王様」、ＡＩ投資の成算に厳しい視線
12:38 配信

写真は中国・上海で開催された世界人工知能会議（WAIC）で揚げられたAI（人工知能）の看板。2023年7月、上海で撮影。 REUTERS/Aly Song（ロイター） Aditya Soni　Deborah Mary Sophia

[２９日 ロイター] - キャッシュフローが王座に返り咲いた－－。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資があまりにも膨れ上がった今、米株式市場では巨大テクノロジー企業の現金創出能力が再び重視されるようになっている。

米ビックテックの決算で、投資家から評価されたのが、際限なく資金調達することなくＡＩ投資資金をまかなえることを示したマイクロソフトとオラクルだ。

対照的にグーグル親会社アルファベットは巨額のキャッシュ流出が嫌気され、さらにＡＩ事業拡大の原資となってきた検索部門の成長鈍化に懸念が強まっている。

アマゾン・ドット・コムも、約５年ぶりの高いクラウド事業成長率を達成したにもかかわらず、第３・四半期の大幅なキャッシュ流出と慎重な第４・四半期見通しを受けて売りを浴びた。

アルファベット株は２９日に１２％超下がり、時価総額約５０００億ドルを喪失。下落率は同社株にとって過去最大となった。アマゾン株も決算発表後の時間外取引で一時６％超下落した。

マイクロソフト株は一時上昇したものの、９年超ぶりとなる米国での投資適格債発行で２５０億ドルの調達を計画しているとの報道を受け、上げ幅を縮小し、ほぼ横ばいで取引を終えた。

これらの市場の反応は、今まで投資家がコンピューティング能力確保のための積極投資を容認し、時には借り入れによる資金調達さえ歓迎してきたのに対して、今後はそうした投資による成長が次の投資資金を十分賄えるのかを、より厳しく見極めようとしていることを物語っている。

その兆候は既にメタの値動きで見られていた。先週公表した決算では、予想を上回る増収と強気の見通しを示したにもかかわらず、大幅なキャッシュ流出が注目され、市場の反応は鈍かった。

一方、オラクル株は２８日の通常取引で約１１％上昇した。外部資金調達に上限を設ける方針を示し、２０２８年度下期にはキャッシュフローが黒字化するとの見通しを示したことが好感されたためだ。

ザックス・インベストメント・マネジメントのチーフ市場ストラテジスト、ブライアン・マルベリー氏は「４大クラウド事業者全てでクラウド需要とＡＩ需要の伸びが確認された。ただ、事業運営という観点では、マイクロソフトだけが成長投資を続けながら同時にキャッシュも生み出しているように見える」と分析した。

マイクロソフトも負債による資金調達を始めているが、その規模は同業他社に比べればなお小さい。今年に入ってからグーグルは債券発行や株式発行を通じて１４００億ドル超を調達し、メタは６２５億ドル、アマゾンは債券発行で９８０億ドルを確保している。

アマゾンは９月３０日までの１２カ月間で４２４億ドルのキャッシュ流出を計上。第３・四半期の設備投資は７７２億６０００万ドルと市場予想を大きく上回った。アンディ・ジャシー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、２６年の２２００億ドル規模の投資に続き、２７年にはさらに大幅な投資拡大を見込むと述べた。

インベスティング・ドットコムのシニアアナリスト、ジェシー・コーエン氏は「重要なのは表面的な業績数字ではなく、その裏側にあるキャッシュの流れだ。アマゾンの決算は、同日に急落したアルファベットに対する警戒感が高まる中で、投資家を安心させるような見通しも示せず、二重の失望となった」と指摘した。

とはいえアマゾンは、不安払しょくに向けてＡＩ事業が３桁成長を続けていることを強調。ジャシー氏も、現在の投資が将来的により大きなフリーキャッシュフローを生む事業につながるとの確信を深めていると訴えた。

アルファベットは、第３・四半期の設備投資額が営業キャッシュフローの１２１．４％に達した。これに対し、マイクロソフトはファイナンスリースを除くベースで６８％だった。

この比率が低いほど、自社株買いや配当、債務返済に回せる資金が多く残る。１００％を超える場合は、本業で生み出した資金以上を投資に使っており、不足分を手元資金や借り入れで補う必要がある。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・ビジブル・アルファの調査責任者、メリッサ・オット氏は「アルファベットとマイクロソフトは対照的だった。マイクロソフトは規律ある成長を示したが、グーグルは資金を使い続けており、中核事業も市場予想を下回った。ＡＩがグーグル検索のシェアを奪い始めているのではないかとの疑念を投資家に抱かせかねない」と語った。

グーグル検索の第３・四半期売上高伸び率は１２％と、市場予想の１４．７％増に届かなかった。サンダー・ピチャイＣＥＯは検索件数が過去５年間で最も速いペースで増えていると説明したものの、市場の懸念を和らげられなかった。

高収益を誇ってきた検索事業が直面しているのは、ユーザーの情報収集方法を変えつつあるＡＩチャットボットやＡＩエージェントによる脅威だ。その一方で同社はＡＩ開発にさらに資金を投じており、アナト・アシュケナージ最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は２７年に設備投資が大幅に増加するとの見通しを示している。

＜積極投資必要論も＞

アルファベットの巨額投資は、もう一つの重要なＡＩ事業であるグーグル・クラウドの成長を後押ししている。グーグル・クラウドの売上高は３０７億１０００万ドルと倍増以上の伸びを示した。しかし、その成長を上回る投資負担が利益を圧迫し、第２・四半期に初のマイナス・フリーキャッシュフローを記録した後、今回のキャッシュ流出額は９０億７０００万ドルに達した。

それでもアルファベット株を保有するチェック・キャピタルのシニア投資責任者、ジェレミー・サルツバーグ氏は「今のグーグルは３年、５年、１０年前とはまったく異なる事業になっている」と主張。投資拡大への懸念に反論して「オープンＡＩやアンソロピックがＡＩモデル開発競争で先行しているように見える中、競争力を維持するには巨額投資が不可欠だ。これは王者だけが戦える競技で、来年１５００億ドルを設備投資に投じる余力がないのであれば、最初から参加しない方がいい」と積極投資の必要性に言及した。

＜マイクロソフトの存在感突出＞

もっとも、主要クラウド事業者４社の中で際立った存在感を示したのは、やはりマイクロソフトだった。同社は７－９月期に１８６億ドルのフリーキャッシュフローを計上した。これは市場予想を約１００億ドル上回る水準であり、同時に４５２億ドルを投じて計算処理基盤の拡張も進めている。

クラウド事業「アジュール」の売上高は４８％増と市場予想を上回り、会社側は１０－１２月期も市場予想を超えるクラウド成長率を見込んでいる。

また今回の決算からは、ＡＩ需要がこれまでの支えとなってきたオープンＡＩなど一部の大口顧客に限られず、より広範な市場へ拡大している様子もうかがえる。

サティア・ナデラＣＥＯは「目新しい技術ばかりに注目する時期は過ぎつつある。多くの企業が、最新かつ最も高性能なＡＩモデルを試す段階から、長期契約を結ぶ段階へ移りつつある」と説明した。

その上で「われわれが重視しているのは裾野の広がりだ。大口顧客の中には当社から購入したいと考える企業が多い。適正な価格であれば提供するし、そうでなければ焦らず裾野を広げていく」と語った。

items.title: El plan de Warsh para reducir decisiones de tasas de la Fed preocupa al mercado de bonos del Tesoro
items.author: Ye Xie, Edward Bolingbroke
items.summary: El presidente de la Fed propone pasar gradualmente de ocho a seis decisiones de tasas al año y eliminar las orientaciones prospectivas, un cambio que podría provocar mayores ajustes en los rendimiento ...
items.body: Bloomberg — A los inversores les preocupa que el plan del presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, de reducir el número de decisiones sobre las tasas de interés al año pueda ser una receta para una mayor volatilidad en el mercado de bonos del Tesoro, valorado en US$32 billones. Anunciado por Warsh después de que la Fed mantuviera las tasas sin cambios en la reunión de política monetaria del miércoles, el plan supondría un cambio gradual de ocho a seis decisiones sobre las tasas de interés al año, reservándose las dos reuniones restantes para debates estratégicos más amplios. Esta medida, que reduciría el número de decisiones a siete el próximo año, tiene por objeto proporcionar a los responsables “tiempo y margen” para deliberar, según afirmó. Ver más: Fed ajustará progresivamente su calendario de reuniones a partir de 2027, dice Warsh Para los operadores, sin embargo, esto se suma a un cambio más amplio impulsado por Warsh hacia una Fed menos predecible, incluida su renuncia a las orientaciones prospectivas —que, en esencia, anticipan los movimientos de política monetaria—, lo que podría aumentar la turbulencia en los mercados con el tiempo. Unos intervalos más amplios entre las decisiones podrían significar que la Fed se vea obligada ocasionalmente a aplicar recortes o subidas de tasas más pronunciadas, señalaron. Este cambio también aumenta la probabilidad de que se adopten medidas de emergencia entre las reuniones programadas, lo que podría provocar mayores oscilaciones en los títulos a corto plazo e incrementar la prima que exigen los inversores por mantener deuda a más largo plazo. “Esta es la señal más clara hasta la fecha de que su Fed no tiene interés alguno en actuar como supresor de la volatilidad en las tasas de interés, y está perfectamente dispuesta a aumentar la volatilidad con anuncios sorpresa si las condiciones lo justifican”, afirmó Isaac Wheeler, director general de estrategia de balance en Derivative Path. Un menor número de decisiones de política monetaria también podría reducir las oportunidades de que la Fed endurezca la política monetaria en el ciclo actual, durante el cual se espera que continúe subiendo las tasas para contener la inflación. Esto resulta alcista para los rendimientos a corto plazo en general, incluso aunque la incertidumbre política amenace con elevar las tasas a largo plazo, según señalaron los operadores. Ver más: La Fed mantiene las tasas de interés y espera más datos antes de decidir su próximo movimiento El anuncio, junto con el tono moderado de Warsh en la rueda de prensa, contribuyó a impulsar un repunte de los bonos del Tesoro a corto plazo el miércoles. Los bonos con vencimientos más largos registraron un rendimiento inferior, lo que acentuó la pendiente de la curva de rendimientos. Los rendimientos a treinta años han subido unos 10 puntos básicos con respecto a los rendimientos a dos años desde el miércoles. A largo plazo, “se está incorporando una mayor prima de riesgo a la curva debido a la aparición de estos episodios de volatilidad”, afirmó Scott DiMaggio, director de renta fija de AllianceBernstein. Warsh ha sugerido que las orientaciones prospectivas limitan la flexibilidad de la Fed y deberían reservarse únicamente para momentos de crisis económica. Desde que asumió el cargo en mayo, ha prometido llevar a cabo un “cambio de régimen” y ha encargado a un grupo de trabajo que examine la estrategia de comunicación del banco central, incluyendo el calendario de ruedas de prensa y el gráfico de puntos con las proyecciones de política monetaria de los responsables. Warsh planteó por primera vez la idea de reducir el número de decisiones de política monetaria en la reunión de la Fed celebrada en julio. El miércoles, afirmó que el cambio permitiría a los responsables de la política monetaria “replantearse las grandes cuestiones”. Ver más: Bessent resta importancia a las preocupaciones por la financiación de la IA y las tasas de la Fed El anuncio del miércoles “marca el inicio de una nueva era de “silencio prospectivo” en la Fed, así como de nuevos cambios en las comunicaciones de la Fed", afirmó Kerry Craig, estratega de mercados globales de JPMorgan Asset Management en Melbourne. Por el momento, los indicadores que miden la volatilidad de las tasas de interés en un horizonte de dos años apenas se han movido, en parte porque aún se conocen pocos detalles sobre el nuevo calendario, según señalaron los operadores. La Fed aún no ha precisado qué reunión de 2027 se convertirá en un debate estratégico, más allá de indicar que será en otoño. Los operadores y economistas señalan que la reunión de octubre, que no incluye proyecciones económicas trimestrales, es la candidata más probable. Ver más: ¿Qué pasa con las bolsas, los bonos y el dólar cuando la Fed sube las tasas de interés? El impacto inmediato también podría ser limitado, ya que la mayoría de los participantes en el mercado apuestan por que la Fed habrá terminado de subir las tasas dentro de un año. Los swaps indexados a la tasa de interés a un día se mantienen prácticamente estables entre las reuniones de septiembre y diciembre, lo que sugiere que apenas habría alteraciones si se descartara octubre como fecha de decisión. No obstante, los inversores señalan que las consecuencias a largo plazo de combinar un menor número de decisiones sobre las tasas con una menor orientación por parte de la Fed podrían ser de gran alcance. “Un menor número de reuniones de decisión, sumado a la ausencia de orientación futura, es una receta para que se produzcan reajustes de precios más importantes en torno a cada una de ellas, así como una mayor volatilidad en torno a las tasas de interés de la que los mercados están descontando actualmente”, afirmó Ali Hassan, gestor de carteras de Thornburg Investment Management. -Con la colaboración de Michael MacKenzie, Greg Ritchie y Ruth Carson. FAST

TOKYO : The Bank of Japan said on Friday it would sell about 860 billion yen (US$5.45 billion) in exchange-traded funds (ETFs) per year on a book value basis, accelerating the pace of sale.
The central bank decided to sell its ETF holdings at a scale of about 0.1 per cent of trading value in the market, it said, as their value has been expanding in the stock market. It will now take about 43 years to complete the sales of its ETF holdings, versus the previously estimated 112 years, it said.
The change will take effect from January 2027.

items.summary: ［東京　３０日　ロイター］ - 日銀は３０日、保有ＥＴＦ（上場投資信託）の売却ペースを２７年１月から簿価ベースで年８...
items.body:
日銀、ＥＴＦ売却ペースを加速　27年1月から年8600億円程度に
12:32 配信

日本銀行のロゴが入った看板。日銀本店で2026年10月26日撮影　 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） ［東京　３０日　ロイター］ - 日銀は３０日、保有ＥＴＦ（上場投資信託）の売却ペースを２７年１月から簿価ベースで年８６００億円程度にすると発表した。現在は簿価ベースで年３３００億円程度を売却している。見直しは全員一致で決定。

新たな売却額は時価ベースでは年２兆４６００億円程度で、市場全体の売買代金に占める年間売却額の割合は現在の０．０５％程度から０．１％程度に変わる。このペースでの売却を進めた場合、売却完了までの期間は約４３年になるという。これまでのペースでは約１１２年だった。

従来通り、市場等の状況に応じ、売却ペースの範囲内で売却額の一時的な調整、停止を行うことができるとしている。

日銀はＥＴＦ売却ペース加速の背景として、今年１月から売却を始めたが、「市場に大きな影響を与えることなく円滑に進めている」と評価し、株式市場全体の売買代金が拡大していることも踏まえたと声明で説明している。

items.title: バーレ、第3四半期の中核利益20％減　鉄鉱石生産は予想下回る
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Andre Romani

[サンパウロ ２９日 ロイター] - ブラジル鉱業大手バーレが２９日発表した第３・四半期決算...
items.body:
バーレ、第3四半期の中核利益20％減　鉄鉱石生産は予想下回る
12:28 配信

バーレが運営するカパネマ鉄鉱山。2025年9月4日撮影　 REUTERS/Washington Alves（ロイター） Andre Romani

[サンパウロ ２９日 ロイター] - ブラジル鉱業大手バーレが２９日発表した第３・四半期決算は、中核利益が前年同期比２０％減少した。鉄鉱石価格の下落と燃料費・輸送費の上昇が響いた。

利払い・税金・減価償却前利益（ＥＢＩＴＤＡ）のプロフォーマ調整後ベースは３５億１０００万ドルと、市場予想とほぼ一致。一方、四半期の鉄鉱石生産量は予想を下回った。

ブラジルのセラノルテ鉱山群で粗鉱供給が減ったことなどから、鉄鉱石生産量は６％減の８８４０万トンとなり、ビジブル・アルファがまとめた市場予想の９０１０万トンに届かなかった。

ただ、２０２６年の鉄鉱石生産量については、３億３５００万─３億４５００万トンとする予想レンジの下限を達成できると表明。また、環境被害が生じたために年初から操業を停止していたブラジルのファブリカ鉱山で９月に操業を再開したと明らかにした。

鉄鉱石価格はここ数カ月、主要消費国である中国の需要減少観測と主要生産会社からの潤沢な供給を背景に下落している。粉鉱の平均実現販売価格は１トン当たり８５ドルと、１０％下落した。

粉鉱の総コストは２３％増加。軽油や船舶燃料の高騰に加え、イラン戦争を受けて上昇した輸送費が主な要因となった。

明るい材料となったのは純売上高で２％増の１０６億ドル。ビジブル・アルファがまとめた市場予想の１０４億ドルを上回った。銅・ニッケル事業の伸びが寄与したほか、在庫の取り崩しにより製鉄原料の販売が横ばいを維持した。

２６年の銅とニッケルの生産量について、それぞれ年間見通しの上限に近い水準を達成する見込みだとした。

items.title: Big tech's $750 billion AI bet faces strain with slowing core growth
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: The earnings reports and the ensuing stock selloffs expose the tensions escalating over big tech's transition to new AI-powered products, and the spending required to get there ...
items.body: By Julia Love and Spencer Soper The core businesses of America’s technology giants — the advertising, consumer and retail machines propping up a collective $750 billion in AI spending this year — are starting to show signs of slowing. In some cases, they’re being cannibalized by the very technology the firms are betting the house on. Earlier this week, Google owner Alphabet Inc. reported that ad sales from search and other channels — a business line that accounts for roughly half of overall revenue — grew at the slowest pace in five quarters. Yet the company maintained a capital spending outlook of as much as $205 billion for this year. Amazon.com Inc. said Thursday that growth in both its core ecommerce juggernaut and the advertising business slowed last quarter, before reiterating its plan for roughly $220 billion in capital expenditures this year. Microsoft Corp. and Meta Platforms Inc. similarly maintained their spending guidance, while posting results that ultimately underwhelmed investors.  The earnings reports and the ensuing stock selloffs expose the tensions escalating over big tech’s transition to new AI-powered products, and the spending required to get there. The companies have been issuing unprecedented levels of debt, selling equity, signing multibillion-dollar data center deals and taking on trillions of dollars in future obligations to pay for a worldwide build-out of AI infrastructure. All this while new products are eroding the profitability and drawing attention away from some of their legacy offerings.  Investor patience is wearing thin. Alphabet’s shares plunged by a record on Thursday, wiping out nearly $500 billion in market value. Amazon’s stock was down 7% in late trading. Meta has fallen 10% since reporting earnings last week, when it told investors that it plans to bet even more aggressively on AI while warning that the new agentic AI app Muse is proving to be incredibly computing intensive.  The market is “scratching its head — how does all this pay off?” Dan Morgan, senior portfolio manager at Synovus Trust, said following Alphabet’s earnings.   Even Microsoft, which reported strong growth in its cloud business and kept spending in check, couldn’t avoid the fallout. The company’s shares initially surged after the firm reported that sales at Azure, the closely watched cloud computing division, grew 48% to $33.2 billion during the quarter ending in September. By the time markets closed on Thursday, the stock had erased all gains and was down 0.2%.  Amazon’s results were more nuanced. The company had shifted its annual Prime Day from the third quarter last year to the second quarter this year, which explained some of the slowdown. But analysts had already adjusted their estimates with that in mind, and results still came up short. The commerce giant’s advertising services unit saw growth of 11%, the slowest pace since Amazon first broke it out as a separate category in 2022. And the online stores business grew by just 2%, a level not seen in more than three years when people resumed pre-pandemic spending habits and online shopping cooled.  Those results overshadowed the growth of Amazon’s cloud-computing segment and stoked investors’ doubts about its aggressive investments in AI. Cloud computing was also a bright spot for Google. The cloud division’s sales more than doubled from a year earlier. Operating income more than tripled. The unit’s chief executive officer, Thomas Kurian, joined the earnings call for the first time, signaling the business’ importance to Google going forward.  But investors were more fixated on the cracks emerging within Google Search, which remains the lifeblood of the company. To stay relevant as chatbots such as ChatGPT become more popular, Google has woven more AI into the search engine, including a dedicated tab called AI Mode. But the growing popularity of that feature has hurt the profitability of Google Search. Chief Business Officer Philipp Schindler acknowledged on Wednesday that the firm is seeing “lower monetization” for queries with AI Mode, an admission that sent its stock falling further. Schindler said the company is working to bring more ads to AI Mode and is optimistic about the product’s trajectory. Google has struggled this year to keep up in the AI race against startups Anthropic and OpenAI. If the company can regain footing on AI model development, it will likely resume delivering the returns that investors have come to expect, said Mandeep Singh, an analyst with Bloomberg Intelligence. “With all these transitions, sometimes we get too fixated on the cash cow business,” Singh said. “Given how Cloud has been expanding margins, I feel a combination of the cloud business and search, once they are at the frontier, would take their profitability back to where they were.” It’s also common for new ad formats to launch with lower margins that gradually increase over time, Gene Munster, managing partner of Deepwater Asset Management, said of Google’s lower AI Mode monetization. The firm’s larger challenge is building agents that can make purchases on behalf of users and pocketing a cut of those transactions — a business model that many in Silicon Valley believe is within reach after the success of Meta’s Muse personal assistant.  “The old way of doing it was blue links or display advertising to influence consumer behavior,” Munster said. “The new way is how do you influence the bot.”

items.title: Analysts react to BOJ decision to keep rates steady
items.author: CNA
items.summary: The Bank of Japan kept interest rates steady on Friday, but revised up its inflation forecast and stressed anew its readiness to continue pushing up borrowing costs to forestall mounting inflation risks.The central bank decided to maintain its short-term policy target at 1.25 per cent by an 8-1 vote. Analysts react to BOJ decision to keep rates steady

Raindrops cover a sign with the Bank of Japan logo outside the central bank’s headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, October 26, 2026. REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

FILE PHOTO: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda speaks at a press conference after a BOJ policy meeting in Tokyo, Japan, September 18, 2026. REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon/File Photo

FAST

The Bank of Japan kept interest rates steady on Friday, but revised up its inflation forecast and stressed anew its readiness to continue pushing up borrowing costs to forestall mounting inflation risks.
The central bank decided to maintain its short-term policy target at 1.25 per cent by an 8-1 vote. Board member Hajime Takata dissented to the decision.
Governor Kazuo Ueda will hold a news conference at 3.30pm to explain the policy decision.

KAZUTAKA MAEDA, SENIOR ECONOMIST, MEIJI YASUDA RESEARCH INSTITUTE, TOKYO:
"The outlook report suggests the BOJ has become more focused on upside risks to both inflation and economic activity as it struck a more upbeat tone on exports and capital spending driven by AI-related demand.
"Although its inflation forecasts remain broadly consistent with the 2 per cent target, the BOJ seems increasingly conscious of the possibility that inflation could overshoot.
"Rather than sticking to the previously assumed six-month interval between hikes, it may now be contemplating increases every three months, making the December meeting a credible opportunity for the next rate hike."
DAVID CHAO, GLOBAL MARKET STRATEGIST FOR ASIA-PACIFIC, INVESCO, SINGAPORE:
"My take-away from the initial report is the hawkish outlook on inflation, which sets the stage for a potential rate hike in December... all eyes will be on Ueda during this afternoon’s press briefing and whether he will tilt hawkish or dovish and any indication on how much higher rates can go.
"The surprise news announcement is that the BOJ has decided to expedite its ETF sales, without trying to destabilise the market. While this may initially spook markets, I actually think this is a positive development since the BOJ feels confident enough with the economy and market."
SHOKI OMORI, CHIEF JAPAN FIXED INCOME STRATEGIST, DEUTSCHE SECURITIES, TOKYO:
"By judging that underlying inflation has reached 2 per cent, the BOJ has changed what it is trying to do: it is no longer a central bank trying to get to its target, it is one trying to keep inflation from running away from it.
"That is a different reaction function, and the market should price in it as one. The 8-to-1 vote, with Takata calling for a hike, reinforces the point.
"For rates, that shifts the debate from when the next hike comes to where the policy rate stops."
MASATO KOIKE, SENIOR ECONOMIST, SOMPO INSTITUTE PLUS, TOKYO:
"The ETF was the surprise. I was a little taken aback by that, but its weight is still small, so while it may have some impact on today's stock market, it is something that can be absorbed over the medium to long term without major disruption.
"On prices, the BOJ's language that interest rates are broadly consistent with its outlook, together with the upgraded CPI forecasts in the Outlook Report, was largely as expected. But it allowed the BOJ to strengthen its rate-hike bias and hawkish stance more than before.
"This can be taken as a signal toward a December rate hike, in the sense that the 2 per cent inflation target has been achieved.
"The key points to watch in Ueda's news conference are his explanation on ETFs and his comments on the 2 per cent target."
TOHRU SASAKI, CHIEF STRATEGIST, FUKUOKA FINANCIAL GROUP AND FORMER BOJ OFFICIAL, TOKYO:
"Speeding up ETF sales is a bit surprising. It's unhealthy for the central bank to hold such a big amount of stocks, but I'm not sure if the timing was good in this risk-off environment. I'm a bit worried about the reaction in the Japanese stock market going forward.
"Then in terms of monetary policy, the BOJ said that the underlying CPI inflation is at a level that is generally consistent with the price stability target of 2 per cent. They have been saying the underlying CPI is approaching the 2 per cent target.
"So, the BOJ sounds a little bit soft, probably compared to the market expectation. In the end, this nuance of wording toward the underlying inflation and also just one dissident gives a somewhat less hawkish impression.
"Probably Ueda-san will try to drive safely, especially in regard to the stock market reaction in the afternoon. So if the stock market decline is relatively large, Ueda-san cannot be so hawkish. His tone could be a bit dovish."
HIROFUMI SUZUKI, CHIEF FX STRATEGIST, SMBC, TOKYO:
"Board member Takata dissented, but this is unlikely to be a major market catalyst. The BOJ also announced a revision to the pace of its ETF sales. However, with the disposal of its ETF holdings still expected to take 43 years, the impact on financial markets is likely to be limited.
"A significant shift from its previous assessments, however, was the BOJ's recognition that underlying inflation, excluding temporary factors, had reached its 2 per cent target.
"Recent developments in France and declines in US equities have contributed to a tightening of global financial conditions. USD/JPY has also responded with yen appreciation at times, leaving the BOJ under no pressure to rush into a rate hike."
MASAHIKO LOO, CHIEF FIXED INCOME STRATEGIST, STATE STREET INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT, TOKYO:
"A boring hold, but an important shift in the Outlook Report. The BOJ's recognition that underlying inflation is now around 2 per cent brings its assessment closer to the reality that conventional inflation measures have already been around or above target for much of the past four years.
"Taking its cue from the Fed and ECB, the BOJ has little reason to rush, particularly with US midterm elections potentially adding volatility across currencies and bonds. Ueda can stay data-dependent, keep every meeting live and preserve the next hike for around the turn of the year.
"The surprise was the acceleration in ETF disposals. Cutting the estimated unwind from 112 years to 43 years is substantial, and at least puts completion within a human investment horizon. But 43 years is still extremely gradual, with annual sales amounting to only around 0.1 per cent of market turnover. The message is consistent with the broader normalization story: the BOJ is becoming more willing to unwind its legacy balance sheet, but remains determined to do so without disrupting markets."

Source: Reuters

[東京 ３０日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反落し、前営業日比２．５...
items.body:
午前の日経平均は大幅反落、一時3％に下げ拡大　決算後の米アマゾン急落を嫌気
11:54 配信

写真は2024年12月、都内の東京証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 ３０日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反落し、前営業日比２．５４％（１６３９円６９銭）安の６万３０１９円７８銭となった。米国で決算を発表したアマゾン・ドット・コムや半導体大手インテルの株価が時間外取引で急落し、国内の人工知能（ＡＩ）・半導体関連株を中心に嫌気する売りが強まった。一時３％安に下げを拡大した。きょうは日銀の金融政策決定会合の結果発表や国内主要ＡＩ企業の決算発表を控えており、売りが一巡した後は安値圏でのもみ合いに移行した。

・日経平均はＡＩ・半導体関連株の下げが主導し、一時３．０１％（１９４８円０５銭）安の６万２７１１円４２銭に下落

・米アマゾン・ドット・コムや半導体大手インテルの決算発表後の時間外取引での株価急落が投資家心理冷やす

・日経平均先物にまとまった売りが断続的に出て下げに弾み

・アドバンテストは７％安、東京エレクトロン約５％安、ソフトバンクグループ６％安など関連株は軒並み大きく下落、イビデンはストップ安

・時間外取引の米ナスダック先物は２％超安となり投資家心理の重し。韓国ＫＯＳＰＩ５％安、台湾加権指数３％安

・決算手掛かりの個別物色は活発。コナミグループやタカラトミーは急伸

・東証プライム市場では値上がり銘柄数と値下がり数がきっ抗。好調な決算を背景に底堅さも意識

・きょうは日銀会合の結果発表や総裁会見のほか、東京エレクトロンやキオクシアホールディングスなど主要ハイテク企業の決算発表予定も

・ＴＯＰＩＸは１．３％安の３９５１．２３ポイントで午前の取引を終了。東証プライム市場の売買代金は３兆９０８８億０８００万円

・東証３３業種で上昇したのは、空運、海運、小売の１４業種、下落は非鉄金属、電気機器、ガラス・土石の１９業種

・東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが７４０銘柄（４７％）、値下がりは７７４銘柄（４９％）、変わらずは３７銘柄（２％）

＜岩井コスモ証券　投資情報センター長　林卓郎氏＞

「米アマゾンやインテルの株価急落嫌気のほか、前日のＴＯＰＩＸ銘柄入れ替えに伴う需給の余韻も」

「企業決算は幅広く上振れ傾向がみられ、株価は耐える力はあるのではないか」

「下値めどは６万２０００円を意識」

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Miho Uranaka

［東京　３０日　ロイター］ - 大和証券グループ本社が３０日に発表した２０２６年７━９月期（...
items.body:
大和証Ｇ、7－9月期純利益は7.8％増　上半期は過去最高
11:48 配信

写真は大和証券グループのロゴ。2017年1月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） Miho Uranaka

［東京　３０日　ロイター］ - 大和証券グループ本社が３０日に発表した２０２６年７━９月期（第２・四半期）の純利益は、前年同期比７．８％増の５１４億円だった。投資銀行が苦戦したものの全部門で増益となった。

前四半期比では８．８％減だった。

４－９月累計（上半期）の経常利益は同６９．９％増の１６６３億円、純利益は同３６．６％増の１０７８億円だった。いずれも過去最高を更新し、全部門で増益となった。ウェルスマネジメント（ＷＭ）部門や資産運用の分野など安定した利益を生むベース利益は６割増えたほか、第２・四半期から連結したオリックス銀行も寄与した。

会見した吉田光太郎・最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）によると、 金利が上昇する中で、個人・機関投資家ともに円債への投資ニーズが拡大しているという。

金利上昇を背景に、資金調達手段の多様化を進める事業会社による社債発行が増加する中、こうした社債を個人投資家が購入するケースも非常に増えていると述べた。また、個人向け国債の販売も好調で、上期の販売額は前年同期比で約７割増加した。インターネット経由で個人向け国債を購入するケースも、購入額は前年の約３倍に拡大していると説明し、「若年層も含めた個人投資家の間で債券投資が広がっている」との認識を示した。

大和証Ｇは通期予想を開示していない。ＩＢＥＳがまとめたアナリスト７人による今期連結純利益の予想平均値は２０６４億円となっている。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Hiroko Hamada

［東京　３０日　ロイター］ - 午前のドルは１５７円半ばでの小動きとなった。米金利低下や...
items.body:
午前のドルは157円半ば、米金利低下で一時157円前半へ下落
11:42 配信

写真は1ドル紙幣。2021年11月撮影。REUTERS/Murad Sezer（ロイター） Hiroko Hamada

［東京　３０日　ロイター］ - 午前のドルは１５７円半ばでの小動きとなった。米金利低下や株安に伴ってドル売りが進み、一時１５７．１９円付近まで下落する場面もあった、ただ、ドル売りが一服した後は買い戻しも入り、１５７円半ば付近で一進一退となった。日銀会合の結果公表をにらみ、様子見姿勢も広がった。

・米金利低下、米株先物安、日本株安などを受けてドル売りが進行

・米金利低下が一服すると次第に買い戻しも入り、１５７円半ばでの推移が継続

・きょうは五・十日にあたり、月末に絡む需給のフローも

・取引一巡後は小動きが継続。日銀会合の結果に関心が集まる

・朝方公表された東京都区部消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）への反応は限定的

＜外為どっとコム総研　アナリスト　中村勉氏＞

「米金利低下・株式市場発のリスクオフが意識されて、一時的にドル売りが進んだ。一方、日銀イベントや翌週には米中間選挙を控え、基本的には動きにくい」

「植田和男総裁の会見では、タカ派的なコメントが出てくるかどうか見極めたい。ただ、次回会合での利上げが織り込まれている中で、さらにタカ派的な発言が出てくる可能性は低く、円高材料にはなりにくいとみる」

items.title: エヌビディア、エヌスケールへの信用保証協議　数十億ドル規模＝報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２９日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアが、人工知能（ＡＩ）クラウド事業者の英エヌスケールに数十億ドル規模の...
items.body:
エヌビディア、エヌスケールへの信用保証協議　数十億ドル規模＝報道
11:22 配信

写真はエヌビディアのロゴ。6月11日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） [２９日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアが、人工知能（ＡＩ）クラウド事業者の英エヌスケールに数十億ドル規模の信用保証を提供する方向で協議している。米ニュースサイト「ジ・インフォメーション」が２９日、協議に詳しい関係者の話として報じた。アンソロピック向けデータセンターの開発に必要な借り入れによる資金調達を支援する。

• 報道によると、信用保証は、アンソロピックが利用を予定している米ウェストバージニア州にあるエヌスケールのＡＩデータセンターについて、電力インフラ整備と建設の資金確保を後押しする。エヌビディアはエヌスケールに出資している。

• 契約はまだ締結されておらず、条件は変わる可能性があるという。

• エヌビディア、エヌスケール、アンソロピックはロイターのコメント要請に返答していない。

• アンソロピックは８月、エヌスケールのウェストバージニア州データセンターキャンパスからＡＩ向けクラウド計算能力を借り受けるため、４５０億ドルを支払う契約を結んだ。

• エヌスケールはこれとは別に、約４６０メガワット相当のＡＩ計算能力をアンソロピックに提供する契約についても協議しており、この契約も約４５０億ドル規模になる可能性がある。

• いずれもエヌビディアが出資するコアウィーブやファーマスといった企業を巡っては、ＡＩインフラ拡張を支える借り入れによる資金調達への懸念が高まっている。

TOKYO, Oct 30 : Japan's Nikkei share average dropped as much as 3 per cent on Friday, led by chip-related stocks, as concerns mounted over the sustainability of spending to fund the AI boom.
Tokyo tracked overnight losses on Wall Street, given additional impetus by late earnings from Amazon.com and Intel that showed massive cash burns, sending shares of those companies and their peers sharply lower in extended trading.
"This can be seen as a sign of growing concerns regarding the profitability of AI investments, which is weighing on share prices," said Maki Sawada, an equities strategist at Nomura Securities.
The market was largely unmoved by the Bank of Japan's surprise announcement that it would accelerate the pace of its sales of exchange-traded funds from January, as the central bank held interest rates steady in a widely expected move.

The Nikkei sank 2.1 per cent to 63,290.11 as of the close of trading, after earlier slumping 3 per cent, led lower by chip equipment heavyweights Advantest and Tokyo Electron, which dropped 5.9 per cent and 5.2 per cent, respectively.
Trading has been volatile this week as earnings reports from Japan, the US and South Korea triggered sharp swings in technology stocks.
For the week, the Nikkei managed to gain 1 per cent.
By contrast, the broader Topix was down a milder 1 per cent on Friday, but flat for the week.
Beyond earnings, falling crude oil prices on optimism over Middle East peace talks supported Japanese stocks. Resource-poor Japan depends heavily on energy imports, especially from the Middle East.
Among the Nikkei's 225 components, 123 fell versus 100 that rose, with two trading flat.
Along with Advantest and Tokyo Electron, other notable chip and AI losers included Ibiden, down 15.2 per cent, Lasertec, down 8.8 per cent, and SoftBank Group, down 6 per cent.
Earnings also produced some standout performers, with game maker Konami jumping 15 per cent to be the Nikkei's biggest percentage gainer. Oriental Land, the operator of Tokyo Disney Resort, followed with an 8.5 per cent gain.

Source: Reuters

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ロンドン ２９日 ロイター] - 米金融大手シティと調査会社ユーガブが２９日公表した調査によると、１０月は５年以上先...
items.body:
英期待インフレ率、10月は2カ月ぶり低下　利上げ観測変わらず
11:15 配信

写真は2024年3月、英ロンドンで撮影。 REUTERS/Isabel Infantes（ロイター） [ロンドン ２９日 ロイター] - 米金融大手シティと調査会社ユーガブが２９日公表した調査によると、１０月は５年以上先の期待インフレ率が４％と、９月の４．３％から低下した。

２カ月ぶりの低下となったものの、シティのアナリストは、イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）がこれを受けて来週の利上げを見送る可能性は低いとの見通しを示した。

短期的なインフレ動向やエネルギー価格の影響を受けやすい１年先の期待インフレ率は４．５％から４．２％に低下した。

シティは、１０月も原油・ガス価格の上昇が続き、イラン戦争を巡る緊張でインフレリスクが高いままであることを踏まえると、期待インフレ率低下に明確な理由は見当たらないと指摘。

「金融政策の観点では、家計の期待インフレ率が１カ月低下したことだけで中銀の政策対応の判断に影響が出る公算は小さい。金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）は１０月の数字を政策の方向性を大きく変える根拠としてではなく、幾分好ましい材料として受け止めると予想している」と述べた。

投資家は中銀が１１月５日に０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決めると予想している。シティはこれが「ほぼ確実」とみられるとした上で、２０２７年第１・四半期にも追加利上げの可能性が高いとしている。

items.title: ブリストル・マイヤーズ、四半期決算予想上回る　新薬好調で通期売上高予想引き上げ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Deena Beasley　Sneha S K

［２９日　ロイター］ - 米製薬大手ブリストル・マイヤーズ・スクイブが...
items.body:
ブリストル・マイヤーズ、四半期決算予想上回る　新薬好調で通期売上高予想引き上げ
10:54 配信

2021年5月20日、米マサチューセッツ州ケンブリッジにあるブリストル・マイヤーズ・スクイブ社施設で撮影。 REUTERS/Brian Snyder/File Photo（ロイター） Deena Beasley　Sneha S K

［２９日　ロイター］ - 米製薬大手ブリストル・マイヤーズ・スクイブが２９日発表した第３・四半期決算は、売上高と調整後１株当たり利益がアナリスト予想を上回った。同社は新薬の好調な売り上げを理由に、通期売上見通しを上方修正した。

第３・四半期の売上高は、前年同期比７％増の１３１億ドル。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の１２７億５０００万ドルを上回った。

調整後１株当たり利益は１．３５ドルで、アナリスト予想を０．２１ドル超えた。当四半期に買収関連費用として１株当たり０．５８ドルの特別損失を計上した。

新薬の好調な売り上げを理由に、通期売上見通しを従来予想の４９０億－５００万ドルから４９７億５０００万―５０２億５０００万ドルに上方修正した。買収に関連する多額の一時費用により、通期１株利益は従来予想の６．７５－７．００ドルから６．３５－６．５５ドルに引き下げた。アナリスト予想は１株利益が６．４９ドル、売上高は４９８億９０００万ドルだった。

クリス・ボーナー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は決算会見で「第４・四半期に向けた勢いは良好だ。この勢いが２０２７年も続くことを期待するとともに、後期開発も追い風だ」と強調した。

カンター・フィッツジェラルドのアナリスト、カーターグールド氏は「決算が予想を上回ったことは歓迎すべきだが、投資家にとって重要な材料はパイプラインの進捗だ」と述べた。

ブリストルの新薬は抗がん剤「ブレイヤンジ」や貧血治療薬「レブロジル」を筆頭に引き続き成長をけん引し、第３・四半期売上高は前年同期比１２％増となった。

点滴投与型のがん免疫療法「オプジーボ」の売上高は同６％減の２３億７０００万ドルとなったが、同薬の新たな皮下注射版「クバンティグ」の売上高は３倍以上増え、３億３４００万ドルに上った。

アダム・レンコウスキー最高商業化責任者は「現行薬で強い販売実績を上げ、パイプライン全体も着実に進展した」と述べた。

グッゲンハイムのアナリストらは、同社の成長製品が堅調な四半期業績を上げたことに勇気付けられたとし、既存薬も引き続きキャッシュフローを支えている」と指摘した。

将来の成長の重要な柱として投資家が注目するのが、抗精神病薬「コベンフィ」のアルツハイマー型認知症治療への適応拡大の可能性と、抗凝固薬「ミルベキサン」の開発だ。ブリストルはミルベキサンの心房細動を対象とする臨床試験と、コベンフィのアルツハイマー病を対象とする試験に関するデータを来年中に得られる見通しだ。

FAST

HONG KONG, Oct 30 : The yen gained briefly after the Bank of Japan held rates but revised up an inflation forecast, while the dollar tracked Treasury yields lower as a fresh wave of selling in AI shares triggered a flight to safety.
The BOJ left its main rate at 1.25 per cent in a widely anticipated move, but stressed that its policy has entered a new, more hawkish phase open to raising rates once every few months.
The yen strengthened to a high of 157.115 per dollar, but later gave up those gains to trade steady at 157.67. It is on track to end October broadly flat.
The brief nudge higher was due to the BOJ lifting its inflation forecast for the next financial year to 2.6 per cent from 2.4 per cent, as well as a dissenting opinion from one board member calling for a hike, said Shuhei Uehara, a foreign exchange analyst at Gaitame.com Research Institute.

The BOJ wraps up a week of central bank decisions, with the European Central Bank, the US Federal Reserve and the Reserve Bank of New Zealand all leaving interest rates unchanged as they bide their time amid stubborn inflation and tightening financial conditions. 
But they are by no means done, with energy prices near multi-month highs and no resolution to the conflict in the Middle East in sight. The Bank of England and the Reserve Bank of Australia will be in focus next week, with investors watching their decisions.
"I think this is just a temporary pause. The global tightening cycle is still going to continue and that will continue to be a driver for FX markets," said Khoon Goh, head of Asia research at ANZ.
"The big question is as we enter 2027, whether or not we might end up with potentially even more hikes if the inflation stays elevated."
The euro was flat at $1.1178 against the greenback after briefly dipping to its lowest since May 2025 in the previous session, and was on track for a 1.3 per cent monthly drop.
Sterling strengthened 0.1 per cent to $1.3392, and was up 1 per cent for the month. 
The Australian dollar was little changed at $0.7028, poised for a 1.2 per cent gain for October. The kiwi stood at $0.5634, flat for the month.
NOT THE SAME AS AN ENERGY-DRIVEN RISK-OFF EPISODE
The dollar index, which measures the US currency against a basket of peers, was a shade weaker at 101.85. It was set for a 0.3 per cent gain this month, marking a second straight monthly rise.
The greenback was pulled lower by a dip in US Treasury yields as the safe-haven assets attract new bids. Results from Alphabet this week rekindled worries about AI spending, triggering a selloff in equities.
The yield on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury note was last at 4.8958 per cent and that on the 30-year bond fell to 5.2623 per cent, both at their lowest in over a month.
"The market reaction looked different from a conventional energy-driven risk-off episode," Sim Moh Siong, FX strategist at OCBC, said in a note.
"Rather than supporting the USD and pushing US yields higher, US-centric AI concerns were accompanied by lower Treasury yields and a softer or broadly subdued USD."

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 29 : Nvidia is in talks to offer AI cloud provider Nscale billions of dollars in credit guarantees to support debt funding for a data center earmarked for Anthropic, The Information reported on Thursday, citing people with knowledge of the talks.
• The credit support would help fund power infrastructure and construction of Nscale's AI data centre in West Virginia, which Anthropic plans to use, according to the report. Nvidia is an investor in the UK-based cloud provider
• The deal has not been signed and terms could still change, the report said
• Nvidia, Nscale and Anthropic did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment

• Nscale is also in talks to sell about 460 megawatts of AI computing power to Anthropic in another deal that could also be worth about $45 billion
• The report comes as companies such as Coreweave and Firmus, which are both backed by Nvidia, have been hit by concerns about debt financing behind the AI build-out

TOKYO, Oct 30 : Annual core inflation in Japan's capital well exceeded the central bank's 2 per cent target in October, data showed on Friday, highlighting mounting price pressure and cementing the case for further interest rate hikes.
The data came ahead of the Bank of Japan's policy announcement later on Friday. While the central bank is expected to keep policy steady, it is likely to stress its resolve to continue raising interest rates to prevent an inflation overshoot.
The core consumer price index, which includes prices of fuel but not fresh food, in Tokyo rose 2.6 per cent in October from the same month a year earlier, government data showed, matching a median market forecast. It followed a 2.7 per cent rise in September.
An index stripping away the effect of volatile fresh food and fuel prices, which is closely watched by the BOJ as a more accurate gauge of trend inflation, rose 2.6 per cent in October after a 2.9 per cent gain in September.

The readings for Tokyo, seen as leading indicators of nationwide price trends, underscore the central bank's view that steady rises in producer prices will lead to broad-based, faster increases in consumer inflation.
The BOJ raised its policy rate to a 31-year high last month, with its governor signalling the bank has entered a phase focused on preventing underlying inflation from overshooting its target, raising the prospect of further rate hikes.

Source: Reuters

items.title: France's mounting debt crisis raises risk of fresh Eurozone turmoil, warns Jefferies
items.summary: France's mounting government debt and rising bond yields could trigger a fresh crisis at the heart of the Eurozone, with the risk of financial contagion threatening the stability of the common ...
items.body:
France's mounting debt crisis raises risk of fresh Eurozone turmoil, warns Jefferies France's mounting government debt and rising bond yields could trigger a fresh crisis at the heart of the Eurozone, with the risk of financial contagion threatening the stability of the common currency, according to a report by Jefferies GREED & fear.
ANI | Updated: 30-10-2026 11:41 IST | Created: 30-10-2026 11:41 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

France's mounting government debt and rising bond yields could trigger a fresh crisis at the heart of the Eurozone, with the risk of financial contagion threatening the stability of the common currency, according to a report by Jefferies GREED & fear. The report, titled ‘From the periphery to the core’, said the scale of French government debt and its ownership had made a renewed Eurozone crisis a realistic possibility over the next year, particularly if bond yields remain elevated.
“But what is scary to GREED & fear, and makes a Eurozone crisis at the core, a quite realistic prospect in the next year or so in a world where bond yields remain elevated, is the scale of French government debt and its ownership,” the report said. The concerns come amid a sharp rise in the spread between French and German government bond yields. The spread between the 10-year French government bond yield and the 10-year German bund yield widened from 55 basis points in late February to 174 basis points on October 22, its highest level since November 2011. It has since narrowed to 154 basis points, the report noted.
The report highlighted France's growing debt burden, with government debt standing at around 119 per cent of GDP, or approximately 3.6 trillion euros. It also pointed to the country's high government expenditure, which has remained above 50 per cent of GDP since 1981 and is currently estimated at 57 per cent. Another key concern is the extent of foreign ownership of French government debt. According to the report, overseas investors held 58.4 per cent of French long-term general government debt securities outstanding at the end of the second quarter of 2026, the highest share since the first quarter of 2016.
The report also flagged the possibility of Japanese investors selling French bonds as one factor behind the recent market pressure, while clarifying that this was an assessment rather than a confirmed explanation. Japanese institutions, including life insurers, have growing incentives to repatriate overseas investments as domestic bond yields become more attractive. Political uncertainty ahead of France's presidential elections, scheduled for April and May 2027, has added to investor concerns. The report said the election outlook was one factor behind the upward pressure on French bond yields, although it argued that the country's debt burden and ownership structure posed the more fundamental risk.
It also warned that a French bond crisis would have consequences beyond the country's financial markets, given France's central position in the currency bloc. “For a French bond crisis means a crisis at the core of the Eurozone,” the report said, adding that a failure to reach an adjustment acceptable to France could lead to more dramatic outcomes, including the end of the euro and a major impact on euro-denominated assets.
The report drew a comparison with the previous Eurozone debt crisis, which was largely confined to peripheral economies such as Portugal, Italy, Greece and Spain. It said the current challenge was different because the vulnerabilities were emerging in the bloc's core economies. It further cautioned that a crisis involving France could have a wider impact on European markets and investor confidence, making the country's fiscal position an increasingly important risk for the region.
The report noted that the French bond market was now firmly on investors' radar, pointing to the country's high public spending, rising debt and dependence on foreign investors as key vulnerabilities. (ANI)

items.title: Halloween: Tracing the centuries-old origins of ‘Trick-or-Treat’
items.summary: Modern late autumn arrives wrapped in synthetic cobwebs, glowing Jack-o’-lanterns and aisles of confectionery. Halloween is widely associated with costumes, decorations, festive activities and the ...
items.body:
Halloween: Tracing the centuries-old origins of ‘Trick-or-Treat’ Modern late autumn arrives wrapped in synthetic cobwebs, glowing Jack-o’-lanterns and aisles of confectionery. Halloween is widely associated with costumes, decorations, festive activities and the exchange of sweets, while its historical roots are linked to seasonal customs and religious observances.
ANI | Updated: 30-10-2026 10:05 IST | Created: 30-10-2026 10:05 IST

People attend annual pre-Halloween High Heel Race in Washington, DC, US. (Photo/REUTERS). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Modern late autumn arrives wrapped in synthetic cobwebs, glowing Jack-o’-lanterns and aisles of confectionery. Halloween is widely associated with costumes, decorations, festive activities and the exchange of sweets, while its historical roots are linked to seasonal customs and religious observances. When children knock on a neighbour’s door today, they participate in a tradition that has evolved over several centuries. The practice offers an opportunity for neighbours to interact, welcome visitors and share small gifts as part of the annual Halloween celebrations.
Ever wondered how these old customs evolved into the modern-day “trick-or-treat”? The origins of modern-day “trick-or-treat” can be traced to several customs practised in different parts of Europe and North America.
Halloween, or All Hallows’ Eve, is observed on October 31. Over time, the occasion became associated with costumes, bonfires, lanterns and community gatherings. These customs developed alongside seasonal traditions that marked the transition from autumn to winter. One of the practices associated with Halloween was dressing up, known in some regions as “guising”. Young people visited homes, sang songs or told jokes in exchange for small gifts such as apples and coins. The tradition of wearing costumes has continued to evolve, with children and adults dressing as fictional characters, superheroes, witches and other figures during modern celebrations.
Halloween also developed a tradition of playful pranks. In earlier times, young people engaged in activities such as moving garden gates, tying door handles together and soaping windows. In North America, community celebrations gradually incorporated organised activities and the distribution of treats. During the early 20th century, the practice of children visiting homes for sweets became increasingly popular, helping establish the modern tradition associated with the phrase “Trick or treat!” Another familiar Halloween custom is carving pumpkins into lanterns. Before pumpkins became widely associated with the festival, people in parts of the British Isles carved faces into turnips and other root vegetables to create lanterns. The practice travelled to North America, where pumpkins became a popular alternative because of their size and ease of carving.
Today, carved pumpkins, outdoor lights and festive decorations are common features of Halloween. Homes displaying such decorations often signal their participation in the celebrations and their readiness to welcome children collecting sweets. The following day, November 1, is observed as All Saints’ Day in the Western Christian tradition. The occasion honours saints and is marked by church services, prayers and other religious observances. It forms part of Allhallowtide, a three-day period comprising All Hallows’ Eve on October 31, All Saints’ Day on November 1 and All Souls’ Day on November 2.
The final day, All Souls’ Day, is dedicated to remembering the departed and praying for their souls. One historical custom associated with the occasion was “souling”, practised in parts of medieval Europe. People, including children, visited homes and received small, sweet, spiced biscuits known as soul cakes, sometimes marked with a cross. In return, they offered prayers for deceased members of the household. Over time, the practice of giving food to visitors became one of the historical customs associated with the development of door-to-door Halloween traditions. While soul cakes were part of earlier observances, modern celebrations commonly feature chocolates, sweets and other packaged treats. The exchange of small gifts remains a recognisable element of the tradition.
All Souls’ Day is also associated with family remembrance. Observances in various communities have included visiting cemeteries, cleaning tombstones, lighting candles and offering prayers for deceased relatives. These practices provide families with an opportunity to remember loved ones and maintain connections with their family histories. Together, Halloween, All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day form a sequence of observances with distinct traditions and purposes. Halloween features costumes, decorations and community activities; All Saints’ Day honours saints; and All Souls’ Day focuses on remembering the departed.
Although modern Halloween is often associated with commercial celebrations, elaborate costumes and bowls of confectionery, its customs carry echoes of older religious and folk traditions. What began as a combination of seasonal practices, community exchanges and observances dedicated to the dead has evolved over centuries into a celebration that brings neighbours together. (ANI)

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 29 : Wall Street's worries about the cost of the AI boom escalated after the market close on Thursday, as results from Amazon and Intel showed the infrastructure race is not only straining the tech industry but affecting consumers.
Surging data-center spending, as highlighted in Amazon's massive cash burn, has turned once debt-light tech giants into major borrowers, while price hikes are squeezing global demand for devices like smartphones and PCs.
Amazon forecast holiday-quarter sales below Wall Street expectations, a potential sign of growing pressure on consumers as inflation picks up, which also hit Intel's PC business, as a memory chip shortage has driven up its costs.
The AI spending spree is also eating into Big Tech's once-enviable cash flows. Alphabet and Meta both burned cash in the September quarter, while Microsoft, the only exception, joined their borrowing binge with a $25 billion debt sale on Thursday.

The tech giants have deep pockets to sustain their spending, but investors have grown increasingly wary of smaller AI cloud firms borrowing heavily to deliver on enormous order backlogs.
Amazon's 7 per cent after-hours slide was accompanied by losses of 5.8 per cent to 6.7 per cent in AI cloud stocks CoreWeave, Nebius and Iren. Alphabet, which closed regular trading down nearly 13 per cent, fell another 1.5 per cent after-hours.
The semiconductor index also sold off post-close after Intel blamed "near term headwinds across the PC industry." The index had already dropped 1.4 per cent during the regular session due to Alphabet's messy earnings report. 
Shares of PC makers HP and Dell sank 8 per cent and 6.8 per cent.
"The revenues missed due to lower PC demand and forward guidance also disappointed. As Google learned today, earnings matter," said Kim Caughey Forrest, founder and chief investment officer at Bokeh Capital Partners LLC. Google parent Alphabet dropped 13 per cent on Thursday.
INTEL FACTORY SHUTDOWN
Intel, whose shares were down 18 per cent, also said a factory explosion in Israel caused a two-week shutdown and would cost it roughly $600 million in lost revenue over two quarters. 
"Overall semiconductor weakness after hours is primarily a function of Intel guide and negative sentiment spillover," said Michael James, equity sales trader at Rosenblatt Securities. 
Some analysts said Intel's problems in the PC sector, an area of technology that does not garner the same scrutiny on Wall Street as the AI buildout, do not seem to necessarily mean big problems for other chipmakers that operate more prominently in AI.
Nevertheless, investors in the less-active post-market trade chose to shoot first and ask questions later. AMD dropped 4 per cent and Broadcom fell 2 per cent. Among the biggest losers in the volatile session was the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull ETF, which offers investors three times the daily performance of the SOX and was off 9 per cent.
The SOX has been one of 2026's standout performers, rising more than 60 per cent as shortages of chips and equipment needed for the AI buildout drive up prices and profits at firms ranging from giant Nvidia and memory chip firm Micron to Marvell Technology. 
But the momentum of that trade has been tested over the past month by tightening financing terms. That has kept some expected IPOs on the sidelines and put some highly leveraged AI infrastructure firms under pressure. The SOX has declined 13 per cent since hitting its recent high in October and is off 21 per cent from its all-time high in June. 
"I think Intel was seen as this unicorn within the tech sector because it was seen as being weaker compared to Nvidia and AMD," said Jake Dollarhide, chief executive officer of Longbow Asset Management in Tulsa, Oklahoma.    
"It just had this miraculous rise, and you got a lot of retail money into it, and some of that money is easy come, easy go."

FAST

TOKYO, Oct 30 : The Bank of Japan kept interest rates steady on Friday, but declared victory in a nearly 14-year battle to hit its price target and signalled vigilance against inflation risks, suggesting the next rate hike could be as soon as December.
With underlying inflation roughly hitting the BOJ's 2 per cent target, the central bank must focus on anchoring it around that level, it said, stressing anew that its policy has entered a new, more hawkish phase open to raising rates once every few months.
The broad shift in outlook aligns the BOJ with its US and European counterparts eyeing near-term rate hikes to battle inflationary risks from the AI boom and the Iran war-induced energy shock.
In a surprise move that marks a further shift away from ultra-loose policy, the BOJ said it would accelerate its sales of exchange-traded funds from January to 860 billion yen ($5.45 billion) per year from 330 billion yen currently.

"Underlying inflation is at a level generally consistent with our price target, and is expected to remain at around that level," the BOJ said in a quarterly outlook report. "Against this backdrop, it will be important to examine the degree to which underlying inflation is anchored around 2 per cent."
At the two-day meeting ending on Friday, the BOJ maintained its policy rate at 1.25 per cent in a widely expected move, forgoing back-to-back hikes to spend more time scrutinising the effects of past rate hikes on lending conditions.
Hawkish board member Hajime Takata dissented to the decision to hold rates, instead proposing unsuccessfully a hike to 1.5 per cent.
"We saw the need to scrutinise a bit more economic and price risks, as well as financial conditions. But underlying inflation has reached levels consistent with our price target," BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda told a press conference after the decision. "Financial conditions remain accommodative. There are various upside risks. We must therefore be vigilant to the risk of inflation overshooting our target."
TURNING POINT
In the report, the BOJ revised up its core consumer inflation forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2028 to 2.6 per cent from 2.4 per cent projected three months ago. It upgraded its estimate for so-called "core core" inflation, which strips away the effect of fuel costs, for the next two fiscal years.
The central bank also said long-term inflation expectations were "moving around 2 per cent," signalling its conviction sustained price and wage gains were becoming more embedded in the public's mindset.
In the previous report released in July, the BOJ had said underlying inflation was nearing its 2 per cent target as long-term inflation expectations heightened gradually.
"In the past, we needed to pay significant attention to downside price risks. We have seen a change in phase. From now on, we must focus on preventing the risk of underlying inflation overshooting our 2 per cent target from materialising," the report said.
While the BOJ maintained its view financial conditions were accommodative, it said real interest rates were "rising recently, although those for short-term zones remain low." In the July report, it said real rates were "negative mainly in short- to medium-term zones."
Declaring victory on the 2 per cent inflation target marks a turning point for the BOJ, which has spent most of its history battling low or negative price growth since gaining legal independence from the government in 1998.
Under former governor Haruhiko Kuroda, the BOJ deployed massive monetary stimulus in 2013 to pull Japan out of deflation and fire up inflation to the 2 per cent target.
Even after ending its mix of unorthodox easing steps in 2024, the BOJ has trodden cautiously in raising rates on the view underlying inflation - or price moves excluding one-off factors and driven by domestic demand - remained below target.
With stubbornly high energy costs and rising import prices from a weak yen adding to inflationary pressures, the BOJ raised rates in September after delivering a hike in June - a shorter interval than the roughly twice-a-year hikes in 2024 and 2025.
Most analysts polled by Reuters expect the BOJ to raise its policy rate to 1.5 per cent in December, followed by further hikes next year. Their terminal rate projection centres around 1.75 per cent to 2 per cent.
Rising prices, however, could weigh on consumption as they prod Japanese households, many of whom have never experienced widespread price gains in their lifetime, to seek discounts.
($1 = 157.8500 yen)

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 29 : Cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase Global returned to profitability on Thursday after three consecutive quarters of losses, helped by lower operating expenses and investment gains on crypto assets that cushioned weaker trading activity.
The results underscore the company's continued exposure to swings in crypto asset prices, with gains in the value of its investment portfolio helping boost earnings even as challenging market conditions weighed on trading volumes and transaction revenue, its largest source of income.
Transaction revenue dropped 43 per cent to $590.2 million in the third quarter, from $1.05 billion a year earlier. Shares of the crypto exchange were down 3.3 per cent in trading after the bell.
The company said macro headwinds have begun to shift and crypto prices rebounded in September.

REVENUE DIVERSIFICATION GAINS TRACTION
Prediction markets emerged as another area of growth for Coinbase during the reported quarter, with revenue exceeding $200 million.
Chief Financial Officer Alesia Haas said prediction markets and derivatives together accounted for about 25 per cent of its total transaction revenue, while subscription and services revenue made up roughly 49 per cent of total net revenue.
"We are seeing the investments that we've made over the past few years to really diversify our revenue, really come to our benefit," Haas said.
Coinbase's prediction markets had become one of the fastest-growing products in the company's history, helping drive additional spot trading volume, Third Bridge analyst Jacob Zuller said.
The expansion also reflects its strategy of diversifying revenue streams beyond its core transaction business, which remains heavily dependent on crypto-market activity.
"They (Coinbase) also treat the category (prediction markets) as near-term revenue, with derivatives as the longer bet," said Colby Howard, president of Heron Events at Heron Intelligence.
"They also see prediction markets as a way in, with traders who start making money moving up to the paid tier," Howard said.
Total operating expenses in the third quarter fell about 17 per cent to $1.15 billion, compared with $1.39 billion in the prior year.
The Wilmington, Delaware-based firm reported a profit of $718.7 million, or $2.51 per share, for the quarter ended September 30, compared with $432.6 million, or $1.50 per share, a year earlier.

Oil prices climbed in early trade on Friday on supply concerns after Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis stepped up attacks on Saudi Arabia, on track for a fourth straight monthly gain and the steepest since July.
Brent crude futures rose 86 cents, or 0.75%, to $115.74 a barrel as of 0122 GMT. US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures rose 72 cents, or 0.71%, to $102.72.
For the month, Brent was on course to finish nearly 14% higher, while WTI was heading for a 15% jump to close above $100 for the first time since April.
On Thursday, the Houthis said they had attacked several sites in Saudi Arabia, including its largest oil refinery, Ras Tanura, the Rabigh refinery and an Aramco facility in Abqaiq, while a Saudi-led coalition said it had intercepted a cruise missile launched by the Houthis towards the kingdom's western region.

FAST

Oct 29 : Walmart said on Thursday it had extended its agreement with AI robotics firm Symbotic, committing about $6 billion over several years to bring more automation capabilities to its distribution network.
Symbotic has been helping Walmart automate its supply chain since 2017.
Under the agreement, Symbotic will bring additional automation capabilities to 25 of Walmart's regional distribution centers in the US and support its supply chain capabilities globally.
Walmart said the agreement aimed to support its e-commerce upstream inventory management, increase storage capacity and improve how products move through the supply chain.
These capabilities will help Walmart offer customers a broader assortment, improve speed and provide more reliable replenishment across its network, the retailer said.
Retailers are increasingly deploying chatbots, along with targeted promotions and loyalty programs to entice shoppers who often turn to AI for product recommendations.

items.summary: The market impact of the possible hacking, which could be the largest-ever crypto heist according to analytics firm Chainalysis, was felt immediately in early Asian trading on Friday ...
items.body:
Home / Markets / Cryptocurrency / Binance's possible hack triggers $3 billion freeze in crypto assets

Binance's possible hack triggers $3 billion freeze in crypto assets The market impact of the possible hacking, which could be the largest-ever crypto heist according to analytics firm Chainalysis, was felt immediately in early Asian trading on Friday

Binance, which allows users to buy, sell and trade digital assets, has more than 335 million registered users globally and had about $160 billion in assets under custody as of the exchange's 2024 annual report (Photo: Reuters)

Reuters 4 min read Last Updated : Oct 30 2026 | 7:25 AM IST

Listen to This Article

Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, said on Thursday it had frozen $3 billion in crypto assets as it investigated a potential security breach, with stablecoin issuers Circle and Tether freezing related assets.
  "Binance will cover all hacking losses," Binance co-founder Yi He said, without providing more details about the incident.
  The market impact of the possible hacking, which could be the largest-ever crypto heist according to analytics firm Chainalysis, was felt immediately in early Asian trading on Friday.
  Bitcoin dropped about 2% to a six-week low of $77,646 and ether fell around 2% to a two-month low of $2,238.76. BNB, a token originally launched as Binance Coin that can be used to pay Binance fees, was down more than 8% over the past 24 hours at $694, according to market aggregator CoinGecko.
 

  Crypto exchange Coinbase Global slid 4.8% while those of bitcoin buyer Strategy fell nearly 6% in extended US trading.
Also Read

Crypto investors must research; invest only what they can lose: Experts

BFSI Insight Summit: Crypto industry calls for greater regulatory clarity

Crypto industry leaders flag tax hurdles, seek regulatory clarity in India

Crypto boom or risk trap? Experts explain what young investors need to know

Tokenisation offers common ledger for real-world assets, says Edul Patel

Binance said the amount frozen could increase as it worked with law enforcement agencies, token issuers, blockchain intelligence firms and other industry partners to trace and freeze additional assets.
  Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao, who no longer runs the company, said in a post on X that the incident "looked like a hack."
  Binance, which allows users to buy, sell and trade digital assets, has more than 335 million registered users globally and had about $160 billion in assets under custody as of the exchange's 2024 annual report.  

BINANCE HAS SECURE ASSET FUND   Binance runs a secure asset fund for users, according to its website, which is a reserve held entirely in bitcoin that is intended to protect user assets in cases of security breaches.
  "It's becoming very hard to counter hacks as AI can find vulnerabilities faster than you can fix them, said Bernardo Brites, CEO of Trace Finance, a payments and stablecoin infrastructure company.
  "My view is that users will move away from smaller and medium-sized exchanges, (it is) becoming too risky to park your money somewhere that couldn't cover a hack of meaningful size."
  Tether said it had frozen nearly $1.57 billion in assets linked to the incident, while Circle froze more than $800 million.

  Binance said it was conducting security checks and would resume withdrawals once the issue was fully resolved. It added user funds remained safe and that teams were reviewing the incident.
  The exchange also temporarily suspended trading on its Binance Alpha platform as a precaution.
  World Liberty Financial, a crypto company linked to US President Donald Trump and his family, said on Thursday it had worked with cryptocurrency custodian BitGo to freeze funds stolen in what it described as a Binance hack. Binance's Yi said $27 million in stablecoins and about $2 million worth of World Liberty tokens had been frozen.
  Crypto firm Ripple also froze roughly $200 million in funds, Yi said. Jack McDonald, senior vice president of stablecoins at Ripple, said the company was closely monitoring reports of a potential exploit involving Binance and was freezing affected funds and coordinating with relevant parties.  

INCIDENT ADDS TO STRING OF CRYPTO THEFTS   Miguel Morel, CEO of blockchain intelligence firm Arkham, said data indicated that billions of dollars appeared to have been hacked from Binance by an unknown actor, though the exact cause had not been confirmed. Morel said the incident began around 4:30 p.m. EDT (2030 GMT) and appeared to be ongoing.
  The incident adds to a string of crypto thefts. Last year, attackers stole $2.9 billion worth of cryptocurrency across nearly 150 attacks, according to researchers at TRM Labs. In September, cryptocurrency exchange Bitget said roughly $350 million in crypto had been stolen from its platform, underscoring the industry's vulnerability to hackers.

  Authorities have warned that organised crime groups are increasingly using cryptocurrencies to move funds across borders outside the traditional financial system.
  Binance.US, a separate cryptocurrency exchange, said it was not affected by the security incident.
  Coinbase said it was unaffected and was monitoring the situation.
  In an unrelated incident earlier on Thursday, prediction market operator Polymarket temporarily halted trading after a security incident involving a third-party provider. It later resumed trading and said it would fully reimburse affected traders.

items.title: China-Philippines Tensions Flare Again at ASEAN Defense Gathering
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: By Mikhail Flores and Joe Cash Tensions between the Philippines and China resurfaced at the close of a two-day ASEAN defense gathering on Thursday, with Beijing accusing an unnamed Philippine politician of obstructing its participation and Manila saying China had been given an opportunity to …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
By Mikhail Flores and Joe Cash

Tensions between the Philippines and China resurfaced at the close of a two-day ASEAN defense gathering on Thursday, with Beijing accusing an unnamed Philippine politician of obstructing its participation and Manila saying China had been given an opportunity to state its position.

China’s defense ministry said the “self-serving” politician had “imposed obstacles to China’s participation” in the expanded ASEAN defense ministers’ meeting in Cebu, without identifying the person.

Its spokesperson Zhang Xiaogang said at a press conference the actions ran counter to the meeting’s open and inclusive spirit, violated diplomatic norms, and undermined China’s rights as a dialogue partner.

China was represented at the meeting by a military attaché in the absence of Defense Minister Dong Jun, who was likely attending a key Chinese Communist Party meeting in Beijing this week.

Philippine Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro, who chaired the meetings, did not directly address the Chinese allegation of obstruction but said Beijing had been given the opportunity to present its views and that no ASEAN member raised similar concerns.

“The important fact is they were able to articulate their position on regional maritime security with little additions,” Teodoro said at his closing press conference. The Philippines has said its defense ministry sent notice to its Chinese counterpart with an invitation to join the forum.

“We allowed the exchange of views to be robust, and I think that was the important thing, the opportunity to be heard,” Teodoro said.

Relations between Beijing and Manila have soured amid repeated confrontations in the disputed South China Sea and, more recently, Chinese sanctions imposed on Teodoro.

The exchange put the spotlight back on that increasingly fraught relationship after defense officials at the annual gathering stressed practical cooperation and sought to find areas of agreement despite differences over the South China Sea and other regional security issues.

Philippines Defends Growing Network of Defense Partnerships

Washington used the gathering to reaffirm its commitment to the region, with U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Wednesday pledging the U.S. would defend its interests and those of allies and partners while proposing greater defense cooperation with the 11-member bloc.

China claims sovereignty over almost the entire South China Sea via a nine-dash line on its maps that cuts into parts of the exclusive economic zones of Malaysia, Vietnam, the Philippines, Brunei and Indonesia. An international arbitral tribunal ruled in 2016 that China’s sweeping claims have no basis under international law, a decision Beijing rejects.

During bilateral meetings with several counterparts, including from other South China Sea claimant states, Teodoro stressed the importance of the 2016 ruling, arguing that its underlying principles were part of international law and not solely a Philippine matter.

In talks with Japanese Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi, the two expressed serious concerns over the increasing scale and frequency of what they described as China’s coercive activities in disputed waters.

Teodoro also defended his country’s growing network of defense partnerships and rejected suggestions they undermined regional stability, saying the Philippines faced “unilateral and illegal claims made by China over its maritime domain.”

“If other ASEAN countries were subjected to the same kind of action in the magnitude the Philippines is experiencing, I am sure that they would resist this to the best of their ability,” Teodoro said as he reiterated the country’s commitment to peace and security.

items.title: DoorDash to acquire grocery delivery platform Instacart in USD 17 billion deal
items.summary: US-based food delivery company DoorDash on Thursday announced an agreement to acquire grocery delivery platform Instacart in a deal valued at approximately USD 17 billion, as consolidation gathers ...
items.body:
DoorDash to acquire grocery delivery platform Instacart in USD 17 billion deal US-based food delivery company DoorDash on Thursday announced an agreement to acquire grocery delivery platform Instacart in a deal valued at approximately USD 17 billion, as consolidation gathers pace in the global food and grocery delivery market.
ANI | Updated: 29-10-2026 21:38 IST | Created: 29-10-2026 21:38 IST

DoorDash logo (Photo/X@DoorDash). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

US-based food delivery company DoorDash on Thursday announced an agreement to acquire grocery delivery platform Instacart in a deal valued at approximately USD 17 billion, as consolidation gathers pace in the global food and grocery delivery market. According to a joint statement issued by the two companies, DoorDash will acquire Instacart for USD 65 per share, representing a 26 per cent premium to Instacart's closing share price on October 22, the last trading day before reports of a possible transaction emerged.
"DoorDash, Inc. (NASDAQ: DASH) and Maplebear Inc. (d.b.a. Instacart, NASDAQ: CART) today announced a definitive agreement under which DoorDash will acquire Instacart for a total value of $65.00 for each Instacart share, or an equity value of approximately $17 billion," the companies said in the statement. The transaction will involve at least 75 per cent cash, while DoorDash shares will account for no more than 25 per cent of the total consideration. Instacart shareholders can choose to receive cash, DoorDash shares or a combination of both, subject to certain conditions.
Shares of DoorDash rose nearly 6 per cent in early US trading on Thursday, following the acquisition announcement and stronger-than-expected quarterly revenue. Instacart shares were largely unchanged at USD 58.35, according to Reuters. The acquisition comes amid growing consolidation in the global food delivery industry, as companies face rising operating costs, increasing competition and pressure to expand beyond restaurant deliveries.
The industry has witnessed several major transactions, including DoorDash's acquisition of Deliveroo in 2025 and Uber's agreement to acquire Germany's Delivery Hero in July 2026. The proposed acquisition will combine DoorDash's delivery network with Instacart's grocery technology and retail partnerships, strengthening its position against large retailers such as Amazon and Walmart.
Tony Xu, co-founder and CEO of DoorDash, said, "Instacart has spent years learning to do that well for grocers, while DoorDash has built a delivery network and technology that local stores rely on every day." The companies said Instacart customers could gain access to more than 50,000 additional stores. They also plan to combine DashPass and Instacart+ memberships, potentially saving subscribers an estimated USD 100 million annually.
Following the acquisition, DoorDash expects to retain Instacart's brand, application and enterprise technology products. The transaction is expected to close by the end of 2027 or in the first half of 2028, subject to Instacart shareholder approval and regulatory clearances, including antitrust review in the United States. Until then, both companies will continue operating independently. (ANI)
